idea-plugin.name: Swift LSP
idea-plugin.description:
Experimental. Provides Swift language support through SourceKit-LSP from an existing Swift toolchain, including code completion, diagnostics, hover, and navigation.

Requires a complete user-installed Swift toolchain with both swift and sourcekit-lsp, including its platform SDK and runtime, on the project execution host. Swift and SourceKit-LSP are never downloaded or installed by this plugin.

Finds the toolchain on PATH or in common Windows installation locations. To select a toolchain explicitly, set SWIFT_TOOLCHAIN in Settings | Languages & Frameworks | Language Servers | Swift (SourceKit-LSP) | Environment variables.
idea-plugin.change-notes: Initial experimental release with SourceKit-LSP integration for Swift files, automatic toolchain discovery, and configurable toolchain selection.
